# Fusebox

> Fusebox keeps every MCP server and Skill for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop, Hermes) in one place, makes them load on demand, and stores their API keys once.

Repository: https://github.com/risingjerry/fusebox
License: MIT
Platforms: macOS 14+ (CLI and app), Linux (CLI)
Install: `brew install risingjerry/tap/fusebox` (CLI), `brew install --cask risingjerry/tap/fusebox` (app), or `scripts/install.sh` from source.
Formerly: Agent Switch.

## What it does

- Two states for every MCP server and Skill: resident (always loaded) or on demand (found and loaded when a task needs it).
- `agent-hub`: one stdio MCP per agent that starts real MCP servers on first call, with only their declared secrets, and stops them when idle.
- `fusebox find WORDS`: one ranked catalog of Skills and MCP servers, English or Chinese.
- Writes each agent's native config from one registry; manages only `agent-*` MCP entries and its own marked instruction blocks; backs up every file it changes.
- `fusebox skills usage`, `fusebox advise`, `fusebox eval`: usage from session transcripts, suggested changes as commands, and a discovery benchmark on your own sessions.

## For agents

- Bundled skill: `skills/fusebox/SKILL.md` (`npx skills add risingjerry/fusebox`).
- Repository guide: `AGENTS.md`.
- Every read command takes `--json`. Secret values are written via stdin or a file descriptor, never arguments, and are never printed.
